open_pull_requests.title: fix(web): logo + wordmark always on screen, Earth turns, home search button works, soft round search page with a bigger globe
open_pull_requests.body:
## What changed (front end only; no API change)

### Latest commit
- **The home's "找交換學校" button works again.** Its submit handler lived in `metro-route.js`, which was deleted together with the route map in #280, so the button reloaded the home. It now fills the search page's own term and language-test fields and opens `#partners` with the typed place (`syncBoard` and the `mt-board` submit handler in `platform-home.js`). The same loss had stopped the board from showing the chosen school's name and the language-test options; both are back.
- **Search page is soft and round** (`metro.css` section 21): the board is a warm tray with round bubbles and a chunky pressable button; filter, my conditions, recent, my schools, the view switch, the sort tabs and the globe's buttons and zoom are tinted pills without outlines. The globe's buttons keep 20px from the window's right edge so none is clipped.
- **Bigger globe window**: at least 700px tall on a desktop (viewport height minus the top bar), and the globe is sized to fill it (`globalCamera` in `partner-map.js`). The home board keeps its square station-sign look.

### Earlier commits in this PR
- The "UniWay" wordmark is always shown in the top bar (it only appeared on hover); the account name shows from 1101px.
- The header of the server-rendered pages (guides, schools, partners) is sticky; privacy and terms get a sticky logo bar.
- The Earth on the home turns in 90 s instead of 420 s (still under `prefers-reduced-motion`).

## Verification
- New tests in `tests/e2e/test_round_two.py`: the home button opens `#partners` with the typed place and term (and works with nothing filled in), the board names the chosen school (the first and third fail without the fix), the globe window height, the buttons inside it with room to spare at 1360/1100/1440 px, soft pills in light and dark, the logo and wordmark and the Earth tests from the earlier commits.
- By hand: home → button → `#partners?view=list&q=日本` shows 7 schools; looked at the search page at 1360 and 393 px in light and dark.
- Browser batch `test_round_two`, `test_partner_globe`, `test_globe_card_and_hero`, `test_partner_space`: 57 passed, 5 failed. The 5 (all in `test_partner_globe`) fail the same way on `main`, checked against a worktree of `main` with its own `src` on the import path.
- `metro.css`, `app.js` and `partner-map.js` have new `?v=` tags, recorded in `tests/static_asset_versions.json`.

## Not verified / known
- I could not reproduce the clipped right-hand button from the report; the buttons sat flush against the panel edge, so they now have margin. If it still clips on your screen, send a screenshot with the browser zoom level.
- The home board and the "我的申請" boxes keep their square look; only the search page got the soft treatment.
- Also failing on `main` (same worktree check): 4 in `test_platform_redesign` and 2 in `test_loading_screen` (browser); 4 non-browser tests (`test_home_and_forum_routes` ×2, `test_frontend_contract` sync test, `test_independent_page_routing`, checked in an earlier pass).
- CI here only builds the images and checks the OpenAPI contract (green on the head); no browser test is covered by CI.

### 核心內容
1. **官方原始資料封存（sources/mcut/）**：

### 1. 官方來源封存與資料溯源（`sources/tcu/` & `official_data/tcu/import_provenance.json`）

open_pull_requests.body:
本批補上兩種可獨立練習的問題：英文聽寫如何保留首次證據並回到聲音訂正，以及學術閱讀如何分清主旨、細節與有限推論。新增 2026-11-09（Asia/Taipei）兩篇完整繁體中文 SEO 圖文指南：

- **用 AI 練英文聽力怎麼做？聽寫 Prompt、漏聽分類與重聽訂正**（`ai-english-listening-dictation`）：三輪可填寫 Prompt、原創參考稿／錯稿、否定遺漏對照、回聽及由朗讀者保管新稿的流程。
- **托福學術閱讀怎麼練？主旨、細節與推論的原創題目解析**（`toefl-academic-reading`）：兩段依 EPA 科學原理撰寫的原創英文、六題四選一、逐項解析、假設比較與錯因紀錄。

選題依候選 17、19 的編輯判斷，沒有 Search Console、搜尋量或排名資料。已讀 main 41 篇庫存、相關正文、最新 workflow／backlog，以及全部四個 open PR #267、#269–#271 的說明與檔案；沒有待審新文章。#255、#266 已合併並排除，開始及建立前沒有本日 PR。隔離分支基於最新 main `aeb46b70`；#78、#92 已合併，無未合併基礎相依。原有 41 篇內容、URL、刊載日與 lastmod 不變；沒有重做保留中的讀書計畫或無實測的三工具比較。

實讀 OpenAI、British Council、ETS 與 EPA 官方資料，記錄版本、查核日、回應雜湊與主張限制。聽寫稿與回饋均明示自編，文字比對不冒充聲音原因診斷；官方參考音檔確認可取得，未做聽辨、語音模型或難度實測，也沒有轉載音檔。科學背景與假設街道比較分開，不捏造研究、溫差、學生案例或官方評分。兩張 Pexels 真實攝影重查授權，沿用 1536×1024 WebP（121,464／88,086 bytes），有正確 alt、圖說與攝影者來源。每篇另有原創 HTML 圖解、FAQ、表格與相關／母校／目的地／選校工具連結。

驗證通過，單元與 E2E 無重跑：

- `scripts/check_editorial.py --base-ref origin/main`：43 篇。
- SEO 單元／整合／release gate 六模組：165 passed。
- SEO 文章／頁面／analytics E2E 三模組：53 passed。
- 兩篇 × 320／390／1440 px，關閉 JavaScript：六組閱讀檢查；15 張畫面已目視核對，手機表格可捲動、頁面不溢出，3:2／2:1 裁切保留主體。
- wheel 建置與 43 JSON／27 唯一 WebP／CSS／renderer／init 共 73 檔逐位元相同，checkout 外可載入 43 篇及兩個新 slug。

[完整來源、授權、驗收、截圖與測試紀錄](https://github.com/blizzard-new/abroad/blob/701b0bd658dd2d097629954905427a80a27ce2e9/docs/seo-editorial-validation-2026-11-09.md)。兩篇同屬本日唯一待審 PR；未合併、部署或要求 Google 索引，PR 不代表已上線／收錄。

任務附件工具已呼叫，但 40 秒未回覆；附件清單也於 10 秒內未回覆，無法確認掛載。GitHub PR 的開啟狀態已另行核對。
